section: Summary of Benefits for the HDHP of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. 2026

rows.You pay: In-network: Nothing Out-of-network: Covered under Traditional medical coverage subject to deductible

rows.HDHP Benefits: Medical/surgical services provided by physicians: Diagnostic and treatment services provided in the office
rows.You pay: In-network: 5%* for covered office visits and 5%* of other covered professional services including x- ray and lab Out-of-network: 35%* of covered professional services

rows.HDHP Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Inpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 5%* of covered hospital charges Out-of-network: 35%* of covered hospital charges

rows.HDHP Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Outpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 5%* of covered hospital charges Out-of-network: 35%* of covered hospital charges

rows.HDHP Benefits: Mental health and substance use disorder treatment:
Prescription drugs: Retail pharmacy (up to a 30-day supply)
rows.You pay: Network pharmacy Generic/Preferred: Member pays 25%* Non-Preferred: Member pays 40%* Non-network pharmacy
